shortDescription: List storage volumes of a storage group (DPM mode)

options.name: _faked_session
options.description: An internal parameter used for testing the module.

options.name: additional_properties
options.description: List of additional properties to be returned for each storage volume, in addition to the default properties (see result description). Mutually exclusive with O(full_properties). The property names are specified with underscores instead of hyphens. Not all properties defined in the data model are supported. For supported properties, see the description of query parameter "additional-properties" in the "List Storage Volumes of a Storage Group" operation in the R(HMC API,HMC API) book.

options.name: fulfillment_state
options.description: Filter to limit returned storage volumes to those that have the specified fulfillment state. If None/null, no such filtering happens. For possible values, see the description of property "fulfillment-state" in the data model of the Storage Volume object in the R(HMC API,HMC API) book.

options.name: full_properties
options.description: If True, all properties of each storage volume will be returned. Default: False. Mutually exclusive with O(additional_properties). Note: Setting this to True causes a loop of 'Get Storage Group Properties' operations to be executed. It is preferable from a performance perspective to use the O(additional_properties) parameter instead.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: The authentication credentials for the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The hostnames or IP addresses of a single HMC or of a list of redundant HMCs. A single HMC can be specified as a string type or as an HMC list with one item. An HMC list can be specified as a list type or as a string type containing a Python list representation. The first available HMC of a list of redundant HMCs is used for the entire execution of the module.

options.name: log_file
options.description: File path of a log file to which the logic flow of this module as well as interactions with the HMC are logged. If null, logging will be propagated to the Python root logger.

options.name: maximum_size
options.description: Filter to limit returned storage volumes to those with a size that is less than or equal to the specified maximum size (in GiB). If None/null, no such filtering happens.

options.name: minimum_size
options.description: Filter to limit returned storage volumes to those with a size that is greater than or equal to the specified minimum size (in GiB). If None/null, no such filtering happens.

options.name: name
options.description: Filter to limit returned storage volumes to those whose name matches the specified regular expression pattern. If None/null, no such filtering happens.

options.name: storage_group_name
options.description: Name of the storage group whose storage volumes are to be listed.

options.name: usage
options.description: Filter to limit returned storage volumes to those with the specified usage (boot/data). If None/null, no such filtering happens.
